requirements.title: Native scope and clock/reset
requirements.description: The complete BTBBranchPredictorBank with both original 128-row target/tag memory types and the supplied reduced ebtb_128x40 dependency is in scope. There are four slots, two ways, no top parameters and no backpressure. All native input bit patterns are legal. State updates at rising clock edges; reset is synchronous active high. Unknown initial storage/pipeline state stays unspecified until initialized. Reset sets only a sweep flag and index; request/update/output pipeline captures continue through reset.

requirements.title: Lookup storage, tags and way priority
requirements.description: Each way contains 128 rows of four 14-bit target entries and four 30-bit metadata entries. The lookup edge captures f0_valid, row pc[10:4] and full pc. Memory read output is current contents of that captured row when captured valid is one, and unknown otherwise. Each slot compares the29 low bits of its metadata with captured pc[39:11], with no separate valid bit. Either matching way is a hit; way0 has priority if both match. Therefore zeroed tags can hit tag zero. Target bits13:1 hold a signed13-bit offset and bit0 selects extended target; metadata bit29 classifies branch, zero classifies jump.

requirements.title: Relative and extended target calculation
requirements.description: A lookup result target for slot j is captured PC plus the sign-extended13-bit offset plus2*j, modulo40 bits, unless the selected target entry's extended bit is one, in which case it is the extended-memory read value. The supplied extended memory has16 rows with folded row h(R)=R[3:0] XOR zero-extended R[6:4]. It captures the current read enable and folded lookup row each edge, returns unknown when that enable is zero, and shares one40-bit target across all slots and both ways for that row. Its writes use the previous edge's captured folded update row, while data and write enable are current delayed-update controls. It has no reset clearing.

requirements.title: f2 merge and taken injection
requirements.description: Every slot registers lookup hit as an override flag regardless of reset/sweep and registers predicted PC bits unconditionally. Its registered prediction-valid is pre-edge not-sweeping AND captured request-valid AND hit. Its branch/jump flags add the selected classification bit or its inverse. At f2, predicted PC valid/bits and is_br/is_jal select that registered prediction on override-hit, otherwise the current same-phase upstream input. f2 taken is upstream f2 taken OR registered-hit AND registered-valid-jump; upstream taken is preserved even on a branch hit. All f1 outputs always copy upstream f1 fields continuously.

requirements.title: f3 pipeline and replacement metadata
requirements.description: At every edge the f3 override flag captures the f2 override flag, and f3 prediction fields capture the pre-edge merged f2 PC/valid/branch/jump fields. f3 chooses those captured fields on its delayed override, otherwise current upstream f3 fields. f3 taken ORs current upstream f3 taken with the correspondingly delayed hit AND valid-jump injection. Reset does not directly clear these registers. Replacement metadata is also two captures: on any slot hit choose way0 if any slot hits way0, otherwise way1; on no hits choose XOR parity of captured pc[39:11] and all29-bit tags for every slot in both lookup ways. io_f3_meta bit0 exposes that choice after two captures and bits119:1 are always zero, independently of request valid and reset.

requirements.title: Delayed target training and signed boundaries
requirements.description: All native update fields are sampled every edge; delayed controls apply on the next edge. A normal update requires delayed valid and no is_mispredict_update, no is_repair_update and no btb_mispredicts bits. Target write selects only cfi_idx_bits when normal AND cfi_idx_valid AND cfi_taken. Delayed meta bit0 selects the written way; row is update PC[10:4]. Compute40-bit modular difference target-(update PC+2*cfi_idx_bits), interpret that difference signed40: offsets from-4096 through4095 inclusive are relative, all others are extended. A selected target entry stores low13 difference bits and the extended flag. Every selected extended update also writes the full target to the shared extended store using its previous captured write row, even during sweeping.

requirements.title: Metadata training and selective invalidation
requirements.description: Outside sweep, metadata slot j writes in the delayed selected way when (target-write-selected[j] OR br_mask[j]) AND (normal-update OR delayed-valid AND btb_mispredicts[j]). The new classification bit is br_mask[j]. Its29-bit tag is zero when btb_mispredicts[j] is one and delayed update PC[39:11] otherwise. Thus selective bad-slot invalidation can write zero tags even while ordinary repair/mispredict suppresses target training; the exact mask conditions still apply. Unwritten entries retain all bits. Meta bits119:1 and all other native update fields absent from these rules do not alter state.

requirements.title: Complete reset sweep and concurrency
requirements.description: A reset edge sets sweep active and index zero. Each nonreset edge seeing sweep active writes all four target entries and all four metadata entries to zero in both ways at the current sweep index, then increments the7-bit index; the edge with pre-index127 ends the sweep. While sweep is active the standard target/tag write address, enables, masks and data use this reset operation, overriding delayed training for those memories; the pre-edge sweep controls also apply on reset edges. Extended writes remain independent. Lookup and output pipelines keep advancing. Compare all native outputs, including invalid-cycle PC bits, upstream fields and replacement metadata; full-width PCs, per-slot masks and both ways remain independent.
